page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at top left. Catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: IIII. Miseros homines exactionibus uexas: no-ua singulis prope mensibus tributa excogitas: etiam leuiculis atque minutulis deliciis multas constituis grauissimas: imo eo quoq; improbitatis & audaciæ deuenis, ut quæ tibi, aut tuis arridènt, palàm eripere aliis minimè dubites.
V. Quæ res sanè facit: ut præ magno dolore, quid ad te scribam, non reperiam.
VI. Tiberius Imperator pastoris boni esse dixit, tondere, non deglubere pecus: & Alexander ille Magnus olitorem odisse sese eum affirmauit, qui herbas radicitus extirpet.
VII. Patres appellantur Magistratus: populi vocantur Pastores.

VIII. Tu verò (erumpat enim vox libera) tu inquàm lupum non pastorem agis: subditorum miserorum, & iam propter annonæ caritatem grauem ac diuturnam, ære oppressorum alieno, sudorem atque sanguinem exugis.
IX. Habuisti tua in familia viros, non tam prudentiæ aut fortitudinis, quàm iusticiæ atq; continentiæ laude insignes: & ne longius abeamus, patrem, antiquæ fidei ac religionis exemplum.
X. Qui profectò non auri argentiq; maiorem, quàm pietatis & iusticiæ rationè habuit: aut satius esse duxit, opes atq; diuitias magnas corradere, q; [?] no men post se bonum relinquere.

page.notes: The catchword "mos" is printed at the right below the last line and completes the word "maximos" begun at the line end. The reading "q; [?] no men" in item X is uncertain: the abbreviation before "no" is hard to read. The word "præ" in item V is marked as read from the scan with the ligature form; the vowels are otherwise clear. The image is cropped at the right edge, so the line ends of some lines may be cut off.
